params.name: select
params.description: Список полей описания, которые нужно вернуть в ответе. Доступные поля: - name — имя поля - type — тип данных - title — заголовок - description — описание - validationRules — правила валидации - requiredGroups — группы обязательности - filterable — признак доступности в фильтре - sortable — признак доступности в сортировке - editable — признак редактируемости - multiple — признак множественного зна…

dynamic.note: Состав полей не описан подтаблицей на этой странице

items.name: callType
items.description: Call type: 1 = instant ad-hoc, 2 = permanent conference room, 3 = large room.

items.name: initiatorId
items.description: User id of who initiated the call.

items.name: startDate
items.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the call started.

items.name: endDate
items.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the call ended. Null while the call is still in progress.

items.name: durationSeconds
items.description: Total call duration in seconds (endDate - startDate).

items.name: uuid
items.description: Opaque UUID of the call session. Opt-in: list this in `select` to receive it.

items.name: language
items.description: Detected transcription language (BCP-47 / ISO 639-1, for example ru or en). Null when there is no transcription.

items.name: version
items.description: Maximum schema version across all stored outcome blocks for this call.

items.name: participants
items.description: Call participants, enriched with display data from user profiles.

items.name: outcomes
items.description: Names of outcome blocks present for this call: transcription, overview, summary, insights, evaluation.

items.name: createdAt
items.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recently stored outcome record for this call.

items.name: tracks
items.description: Call recordings / tracks with download URLs. Opt-in via `select`.

items.name: transcription
items.description: Time-ordered transcription of the call with per-segment speaker attribution.

items.name: overview
items.description: AI overview of the meeting: topic, agenda, agreements, action items, takeaways.

items.name: summary
items.description: Segmented summary of the call by topic chunks.

items.name: insights
items.description: AI insights: per-speaker analysis (CIS only), meeting strengths/weaknesses, recommendations.

items.name: evaluation
items.description: Meeting efficiency evaluation: overall score and individual evaluation criteria.

returns.name: items
returns.description: Массив объектов с описанием полей. Структура ответа зависит от select
